settings.heading: Reading
settings.hide_signatures_help: Don't show the signatures under other members' posts.

admin.layout_help: Where the member's details sit on each post. Phones have no side column, so the panel becomes a line under the name there.
admin.show_rank_help: The member's visible groups — including Ladder's ranks, which are groups.
admin.show_renown_help: With Renown installed: the member's insignia, rank and level (and Prestige emblem) at the top of the panel. Renown's own badge beside the name steps aside on wide screens.
admin.show_best_answers_help: Needs FoF Best Answer. Hidden for members with none.
admin.signature_once: Show a member's signature once per discussion
admin.signature_once_help: Their first post on the page keeps it; later replies don't repeat it. Members can also hide every signature for themselves under Settings → Reading.
